Vuori is looking for a Product Manager to lead our Enterprise Analytics pod. This is the team that builds the cross-functional analytics layer the rest of the business runs on — the semantic layer, executive analytics, certified metrics, and the data governance program. You will own the analytics surface area that cuts across pods: the semantic layer (across metric and attributes), the executive dashboard portfolio, the Vuori data dictionary, and the data governance program. You will sit between the business and the data platform, defining what gets built, how it gets defined, and how it gets adopted. This is a dual facing role. This role will be responsible for executing and monitoring sell through analytics sales trends for the channel as well as the development and execution of sales plans and strategies. Responsible for building and managing the Channel/Rep/Customer forecast tracking tools while ensuring alignment between Wholesale, Finance, and Merchandising Planning teams. Develop, monitor and analyze the key sales performance metrics including but not limited to revenue, margin, inventory levels, brand ranking within the entire channel including the Majors and Key Customers as well as specialty channel. Responsible for the execution of sales forecasting and budgeting process in coordination with commercial and finance deliverables. With support and in coordination with the tech organization, build out and manage the development of the wholesale BI reporting and analytics suite that will support both internal and external sales teams on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and seasonal basis. Build presentations and communicate weekly, monthly and quarterly channel performance updates to leadership team Create visually appealing and informative reports and dashboards that present complex data in a way that is easy to understand and actionable. Will drive special projects and provide analytical support as needed for wholesale and cross functional teams as needed.
